purpose: C-07: distinguish upstream adjoint non-additivity, local weight reduction and FP32 component-sum rounding without changing the model

target.identityRule: jointly verify index/name/parameter graph/module type/source SHA/weight bytes and before-after versions; shape alone is insufficient
target.historicalVersionRule: history sourceVersion must be recorded separately; a new instance's counter must never be forged to equal historical 1016
target.convolutionConfiguration: read and bind actual kernel/stride/padding/dilation/groups/bias/layout from the restored original module; no guessed defaults

definitions.A: observed native weight gradient from actualTotal, cast to FP64 only for analysis
definitions.Bi: three observed native component weight gradients cast to FP64
definitions.E: original FP32 left-associated sum of the three native components, then cast to FP64 for analysis
definitions.T: same-device FP64 linear weight VJP of actualTotal output adjoint
definitions.Si: three same-device FP64 linear weight VJPs of component output adjoints

comparison.decomposition: A - E = (T - S) + (A - T) - (B - S) + (B - E), with the FP64 residual explicitly reported
comparison.interpretation: T-S is upstream adjoint contribution; A-T and B-S are native-versus-reference reduction differences; B-E is FP32 component-sum rounding. Finite reference arithmetic, unknown backend algorithm IDs and after_exception reconstruction limit causal claims. No residual threshold may be used to weaken the original gate.
comparison.upstreamRule: report byte equality, signed differences and contractions; mere closeness of output adjoints is not proof that their weight-VJP contribution is zero

localContrastPermittedOnlyIf: all four original independent G gradient calls completed
all four target captures complete, finite and identity-verified
unchanged complete 108-parameter original gate raises ValueError from the actual gate at parameter 60
original error message is exactly 'actual total gradient identity differs at parameter 60' and origin is independently bound, not caller-supplied text
state, modes and source bindings remain valid and optimizer constructions/updates are zero
gateFailureContinuation.whenExactTargetFailure: Preserve the original gate failure before CP60-04. Continue only evidence calculations; never return gradients to a training update or convert the failed gate into a pass.
gateFailureContinuation.whenOtherFailure: Any other parameter, exception type/origin, missing objective label, invalid state or exceeded quota stops without CP60-04.
gateFailureContinuation.currentInstanceVersionRule: Bind original state bytes but do not forge archived sourceVersion=1016 on a newly constructed tensor. Record new-instance versions and prove unchanged versions during the observation.

stopRules: no optimizer, D update, model fix, train restart, Checkpoint selection/save or visual output
no auto retry, extension of resource limits, extra samples or additional layers
new reconstruction that fails outside parameter60 provides no target60 causal conclusion
not reproduced, unavailable causal evidence or numeric/resource failure ends this route; preserve original failure and all new evidence
acceptance: Exact immutable source and current-program bindings pass CPU preflight.
Complete generator/discriminator state and captured modes match; current instance versions are recorded, not forged.
Small CPU fixtures verify read-only observer, original ordered labels and evidence-only FP64 decomposition with unchanged thresholds.
No actual model forward, autograd, optimizer, CUDA, training, Checkpoint, production registry write or qualification occurs.
CPU actual result and independent regression remain separate from GPU execution and numerical root cause.
